title: Testing Strategies & Determinism
description: Study choose the right test boundary, control time, randomness and services, assert behavior rather than implementation, and interpret coverage and missing cases. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Choose the right test boundary
lessons.description: Design a test that exercises the actual serialization boundary.
lessons.conceptOverview: Unit tests isolate logic, integration tests exercise collaborations and end-to-end tests cover user flows. Choose the smallest boundary that can reveal the relevant failure without replacing necessary integration evidence.
lessons.whyItMatters: Tests must include the boundary where the defect occurs.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Unit tests isolate logic, integration tests exercise collaborations and end-to-end tests cover user flows. Choose the smallest boundary that can reveal the relevant failure without replacing necessary integration evidence.

lessons.title: Control time, randomness and services
lessons.description: Replace the implicit clock with a controlled input and test the boundary.
lessons.conceptOverview: Inject clocks, seeded randomness and fake services when reproducibility matters. Keep a separate integration layer for real dependencies instead of letting network variability dominate logic tests.
lessons.whyItMatters: Deterministic fixtures make time-dependent behavior testable.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Inject clocks, seeded randomness and fake services when reproducibility matters. Keep a separate integration layer for real dependencies instead of letting network variability dominate logic tests.

lessons.title: Assert behavior rather than implementation
lessons.description: Rewrite the assertion around the persisted result and error behavior.
lessons.conceptOverview: Prefer assertions about outputs, state transitions and contracts over private method call sequences. Overly coupled tests fail on harmless refactors while missing incorrect user-visible behavior.
lessons.whyItMatters: Behavioral assertions survive valid internal refactoring.

lessons.title: Interpret coverage and missing cases
lessons.description: Add expected-state assertions for invalid input and recovery.
lessons.conceptOverview: Coverage shows which code executed, not whether assertions were meaningful. Review boundary conditions, negative paths and data variants rather than treating a percentage as proof of correctness.
lessons.whyItMatters: Coverage must be paired with meaningful behavioral checks.
